items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I used to play for Bill Bailey, who was Pearl Bailey's brother.

ctx.x: Anyhow, as I said before, I got very interested in the axe/acts(?) after... I would start playing... To play a dance (?) and try to do anything, you'd have to be there all night and sweat about a lot...you know, sweat plenty anyhow. Anyway, we became very good friends. And of course, Linton throughout the years... When I was with Hot Lips Page, we used to be on the road together. His brother, Linton, by the way, is no slouch on piano, you know.

Anyhow, it seems to me I... At the time I played the Apollo again, and I think...I don't know, I remember... Now, this is before...back in the Willie Bryant days. It was the first time I met Erroll. And during the time, during the acts, I used to play for Bill Bailey, who was Pearl Bailey's brother. Of course, we struck a nice relationship, more or
